acceptance_predicates.description: Setup selects one or more supported agents.
Selections and shared defaults survive a fresh subsequent run.
Human output is default and --json is opt-in.
Missing production authentication never blocks development setup.

definition_of_done: ASB and TUI-compatible implementation merged with independent review and hosted checks.
Fresh-user evidence covers opencode and opendesk selection and reload.

inputs.description: Existing task acceptance, evidence requirements, and development-only constraints.

outputs.description: Strict-schema task specification and generated coordination projections.

gates.description: All existing acceptance predicates and definition-of-done checks pass without weakening thresholds.
